name: Pending Justifications and Approvals Aging
query:
SELECT
    aw.employee AS "Employee:Link/Employee:120",
    emp.employee_name AS "Employee Name:Data:150",
    emp.company AS "Company:Link/Company:120",

    aw.warning_date AS "Warning Date:Date:110",
    aw.warning_type AS "Warning Type:Data:120",
    aw.state AS "State:Data:120",

    aw.approver AS "Approver:Link/User:150",
    aw.justification_date AS "Justification Date:Date:120",
    aw.approval_date AS "Approval Date:Date:120",

    -- Safe Days Pending
    CASE
        WHEN aw.state = 'Pending Justification'
            THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), aw.warning_date)
        WHEN aw.state = 'Pending Approval'
            THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), aw.justification_date)
        ELSE 0
    END AS "Days Pending:Int:120",

    CASE
        WHEN aw.state = 'Pending Justification' THEN 'Employee'
        WHEN aw.state = 'Pending Approval' THEN 'Approver'
        ELSE 'Completed'
    END AS "Pending Stage:Data:130"

FROM `tabAttendance Warning` aw
LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON emp.name = aw.employee

WHERE 
    aw.docstatus = 1
    AND (%(company)s IS NULL OR %(company)s = '' OR emp.company = %(company)s)
    AND (aw.warning_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s OR %(from_date)s IS NULL)
